scripts.install:all: npm install && npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.setup: npm run install:all && npm --prefix server run db:migrate
scripts.dev: concurrently -n db,server,client -c gray,blue,magenta "npm --prefix server run db" "node scripts/wait-port.mjs 51214 180 && npm --prefix server run db:migrate && npm --prefix server run dev" "node scripts/wait-port.mjs 4000 300 && npm --prefix client run dev"
scripts.build: npm --prefix server run build && npm --prefix client run build
